name: Paganism
overview: Scripture clearly condemns paganism as a turning away from the one true God, forbidding the worship of other gods and the practice of occult arts such as consulting familiar spirits and wizards (Exodus 20:3; Leviticus 20:6). The Lord commands His people not to imitate the abominable customs of pagan nations, including idolatry and reliance on signs from heaven, which are marked by spiritual blindness and vanity (Deuteronomy 18:9; Isaiah 44:9; Jeremiah 10:2). The New Testament affirms this judgment, as seen in Paul's distress over the city of Athens being completely given to idolatry (Acts 17:16), underscoring the ongoing call to exclusive devotion to God alone.
